title: Copilot Studio: cost controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: Hold: both Power Platform Copilot Studio paths omit the documented Products heading. The historical claim that spending could previously be governed only at environment level is not supported; the opt-in behaviour, billing model and resource-policy setup are documented.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated a tenant-by-tenant availability schedule or when every tenant receives this experience.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "cost management" "available" "tenants"; opened Manage Copilot Studio costs and usage-based billing overview. Neither supplies a tenant rollout schedule; the roadmap supplies only its October CY2026 target.

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions: agent registry

claims.where: Why it matters, first paragraph
claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Cost Management dashboard gives finance and licensing readers read-only visibility into usage-based Copilot services.
claims.quote: This separation enables finance, operations, licensing, and governance stakeholders to review consumption information with read-only access.

claims.where: Why it matters: instead of only from environment-level settings
claims.claim: Before this change, Copilot Studio spending could be governed only through environment-level Power Platform settings.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Studio" "cost management" "previously" "environment"; opened the feature and Power Platform capacity pages. No historical exclusivity statement was found; the capacity page also documents individual-agent limits.
claims.fix: Remove ', instead of only from environment-level settings in the Power Platform admin center' from the first sentence of Why it matters.
